articles.title: Bring Your Own Agent: Your Employees' Assistants Are Already Logged In
articles.text:
The personal AI agents rollout is going about as smoothly as expected: Amazon now blocks Meta's Muse because it doesn't identify itself as a bot while browsing; Instinct keeps raising privacy concerns; and the horror stories from pretty much every personal AI agent keep piling up.
Regardless, the tech world is mesmerized by the capabilities and potential of these services. Less than a year after the first release of the open-source agent now called OpenClaw, the juggernauts are putting their weight behind the idea that each of us needs a personal assistant.
You know what's coming: your employees will connect their personal agents to work systems. There's no stopping that. Their agents already manage their home time, and managing their work time is the next logical step. For them, that is. Not for your security.
Given that personal agents will reach corporate systems whether approved or not, you might be wondering what the best way is to block them. If that’s your thinking, we’re here to offer you another path: enable safe usage instead, with identity as the control plane, and reap the benefits.
BYOD, meet BYOA(I)
The Bring-Your-Own-Device shift is the obvious comparison, but calling this the new era of BYOD would undersell the challenges personal AI agents introduce. These aren't just devices presumed to be insecure that contain company data, but entire AIs that act on company systems in the employee’s name.
Bring-Your-Own-AI (or Bring-Your-Own-Agent) is, then, an identity challenge first and foremost. The best-case scenario is an agent wielding identities with an owner of record, limited approval, and no offboarding. You will also have agents who pretend to be employees, and agents with identities that have no easily recognizable owner.
But the main difference between the two movements is where the control point sits. BYOD gave IT a device to enroll. A personal agent is something you can't register: it lives on the vendor's computer or blends into the employee's. And it's likely in your systems today, whether you can see it or not.
How personal agents get in
Whoever connects a personal AI agent to your systems today likely does this without ever filing a ticket. Instead, they connect it the way they'd connect other apps:
- OAuth consent. The agent requests access to Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, or Slack, and the employee clicks Allow. If your tenant lets users consent to third-party apps, that's the whole process.
- A text thread. Take Instinct, for example. Users text it, link their Google, Apple, or Facebook account, and it acts through the services they connect.
- Saved passwords in the agent's browser. Many of the agents can sign in to supported sites using passwords via a browser and an internal password manager. To your app, it looks like the employee is logging in.
- API keys and personal access tokens. For unofficial integrations, many agents can use API keys and personal access tokens, which require users to create long-term credentials.
- The employee's own laptop. A local agent like OpenClaw reaches whatever the machine it's installed on can see. Muse got a Mac app on September 18 that reads files, notes, calendars, and email with the user's permission, and can take optional Full Disk Access. Dots can work from the user's laptop once it's connected. The same goes for AI browsers like Atlassian's Dia, which read your open pages and connect to Slack and Gmail.
Meet the agents
Less than a year into the category, we’re already starting to see sub-categories emerge in the nascent personal AI agent market. Some agents are more corporate, and others are more personal. But you’ll be hard-pressed to find one that’s truly tailored to a work environment in terms of what it does, and, more importantly, doesn’t do.
Take OpenAI’s Dots, for example. It’s as corporate as a product such as this can be. “Specialist dots” will have their own identities and credentials. OpenAI is working with Microsoft to deploy them under Agent 365, and the connectors are based on those created for ChatGPT. Even the rollout is limited to enterprise accounts and high-tier subscriptions.
xAI’s GrokBot has an R&D distribution channel via Cursor. If your devs have Cursor, they might have access to GrokBot. Here, the idea is to turn the AI bot tied to the work-controlled development environment into a personal assistant, but that doesn’t make it more governed. Like its competitors, GrokBot is more than willing to sign in to tools without using a clean API via its virtual computer.
Meta’s muse is consumer-first, and currently US and Canada-only. That said, a few weeks after launch, it gained many organizational connectors, including Slack, Linear, and Vercel. It’s also, ostensibly, the fastest-growing personal AI agent in the fall of 2026.
The buzziest personal AI agent in tech circles is Instinct. It’s a personal AI agent from a small start-up that works through text apps. It can connect to pretty much any work environment. And it has a privacy policy that raised many an eyebrow. Speaking of raising, Instinct itself raised $1 billion at a $10 billion valuation, so it’s one of the best-funded underdogs ever.
Finally, we’d be remiss if we didn’t mention OpenClaw. The open-source agent that runs on the user’s own machine is adapting to a future where it’s not the only personal AI in town. It’s trying to go “multiplayer,” with several trusted users operating the same bot while adding features like session ownership.
Everyone is building governance. For their own deployments.
Most of the aforementioned vendors are currently adding controls for managed deployments. So if you trust your employees to use corporate Dots, Grokbot, or Muse, there’s good news aplenty in recent announcements.
But all of these only work inside a corporate deployment. None of the truly personal AI agents will show up in the relevant admin console. This is not to say that you should necessarily block “unauthorized” agents en masse. Your employees are learning to rely on them, and there’s great productivity improvement potential.
Instead, treat the agent as an external entity. Someone else runs it, and the employee owns it. What you do have is the other end: the accounts, grants, and sessions it uses inside your systems.
For users, it’s good to have the agents run on a computer in the vendor’s cloud or on their own server. For you, it’s a headache, even if the vendor's architecture is thoughtful. Take Muse, which runs a dedicated VM with a guard called Sentinel that checks every outbound request, and tokens that the agent itself never handles. In other words, the Sentinel enforces the users’ policy rather than the employer's, and corporate session tokens end up on someone else’s computer.
Local agents running on laptops have the opposite problem. Credentials stay local, but nothing tells the agent apart from the employee.
Enable the agent, govern the identity
So what’s the ideal solution? It looks something like this: employees can benefit from using their personal agent at work, but the workplace controls the reach via identities.
It means:
- Discovering the agents already connected. This is your Shadow AI inventory, which you assemble based on the different ways AI agents access your systems. These can be OAuth grants to agent vendors, sign-ins from vendor cloud ranges, long-lived API keys issued to unknown clients, or EDR findings.
- Attributing each agent to a human owner.
- Right-sizing the agent’s access. A personal agent inherits everything its owner can do, and it's usually asked to do a sliver of that.
- Retiring the agent when the owner leaves, including grants, tokens, and sessions that outlive the account.
Easier said than done, obviously, but some of the fundamentals are there. More will likely be added in the coming months to create the connective tissue between personal AI agents and workplaces. For example, we still need to know if whoever signs in with a username and password is an employee or their agent. Agent-to-agent communication isn’t solved yet. And the ability to compartmentalize knowledge, so that a personal agent loses it during offboarding, isn’t here yet.
Additional controls are coming, but you don’t have to wait for the vendors to catch up. Token Security already finds the personal agents connected to your systems, ties each one to its owner, trims its access, and shuts it off when the employee leaves. Identity is the control plane for AI agents and personal agents are no different. See it on your own environment.

articles.title: Por qué el televisor tiene una luz roja parpadeando y qué problema está avisando
articles.text:
La luz roja del televisor no es un simple testigo decorativo. En los televisores inteligentes de marcas como Samsung, LG, Sony, TCL, Hisense y Philips, ese pequeño punto en el borde inferior forma parte de un sistema de diagnóstico que informa sobre el estado del equipo incluso cuando la pantalla permanece apagada.
Cuando el televisor está desconectado de la pantalla pero sigue enchufado, la luz roja fija indica que el aparato se encuentra en modo de espera (standby), listo para encenderse de inmediato con el control remoto. Ese comportamiento es normal y no representa ninguna falla. Algo diferente cuando parpadea.
Qué significa que la luz roja del TV parpadee
El problema aparece cuando esa luz, en lugar de permanecer fija, comienza a parpadear de forma intermitente con el televisor apagado. Según explica Samsung, este parpadeo puede señalar un inconveniente en la alimentación eléctrica o en algún componente interno del equipo.
No implica necesariamente una avería grave, pero sí advierte que algo no funciona como debería. En algunas marcas, como Sony, el número de destellos consecutivos actúa como un código de diagnóstico: cada secuencia de parpadeos corresponde a un tipo de error distinto que el servicio técnico utiliza para localizar la falla.
Un detalle que suele generar dudas, y que responde a la pregunta central sobre este tema, es el siguiente: la luz roja parpadeante en un televisor apagado generalmente indica un problema de alimentación eléctrica o un fallo interno, aunque en ciertos casos también puede deberse a un botón del control remoto trabado, sin que esto signifique que el aparato esté dañado de forma permanente.
Las causas más comunes detrás del parpadeo
Existen varias razones que explican este comportamiento. La primera y más frecuente está vinculada al suministro eléctrico: una toma de corriente defectuosa, una regleta deteriorada o un estabilizador de voltaje desgastado pueden provocar que el televisor no reciba la energía necesaria.
También puede tratarse de un inconveniente en algún componente interno del televisor, como la placa principal, aunque este diagnóstico solo puede confirmarse mediante revisión técnica.
Existe además una causa menos evidente, que Samsung señala de forma particular: en determinadas circunstancias, el parpadeo constante se produce porque alguno de los botones del control remoto permanece presionado de manera accidental, lo que envía señales continuas al televisor y genera ese comportamiento intermitente en el LED.
Cómo diagnosticar el problema paso a paso
Antes de asumir que el televisor está averiado, conviene seguir un proceso de verificación. Lo primero es desconectar por completo el aparato de la corriente eléctrica y esperar unos 30 segundos antes de volver a enchufarlo, ya que este reinicio permite descartar fallos temporales del sistema.
Una vez reconectado, hay que comprobar que la toma de corriente funcione correctamente. Para eso, se recomienda enchufar otro aparato eléctrico en esa misma toma y verificar que funcione con normalidad.
Si el televisor está conectado a través de una regleta o un estabilizador de voltaje, también conviene revisar esos accesorios, ya que pueden deteriorarse con el tiempo y dejar de suministrar el voltaje adecuado.
Es necesario revisar también que el control remoto no tenga ningún botón trabado o presionado de forma accidental, dado que esto puede ser la causa del parpadeo sin que exista ninguna falla real en el televisor.
Cuándo es necesario llamar al servicio técnico
Si después de realizar todas estas comprobaciones la luz roja continúa parpadeando y el televisor sigue sin responder, la recomendación es solicitar asistencia técnica especializada.
Un parpadeo persistente, acompañado de problemas de encendido que no se resuelven con el reinicio ni con el cambio de toma de corriente, puede ser indicio de un fallo interno que requiere una evaluación profesional.
En el caso de que el cable de poder presente daños visibles, también es necesario reemplazarlo, ya que un cable deteriorado puede ser el origen directo del problema de alimentación y, por lo tanto, del parpadeo del indicador.

articles.title: As laptop price hikes loom, this 32GB HP OmniBook 16 drops to $1300

The OmniBook 16 AI has a 16-inch 2K (1920 x 1200) IPS touchscreen, an AMD Ryzen AI 7 445 with six cores and a 50 TOPS NPU, Radeon 840M integrated graphics, 32GB of DDR5 and a 1TB NVMe SSD. Our report on laptop price hikes says analysts expect more increases ahead even as PC sales fall, which is why a laptop with plenty of memory and storage is a sensible buy now. Price Context & Historical Value
At $1,299.99, Amazon shows this as 46% off a $2,399.99 "typical price", but that figure comes from a third-party seller and may not reflect what this laptop usually costs. A better yardstick is the spec sheet: 32GB and 1TB at this price is strong value for a 16-inch touchscreen. Amazon Visa cardholders can also get $50 off on approval.
Should you buy it?
✅ Buy the HP OmniBook 16 AI laptop if... you want to buy a well-equipped 16-inch laptop now, before analysts' predicted price hikes arrive, and you value 32GB of RAM and 1TB of storage.
❌ Skip the HP OmniBook 16 AI laptop if... you need a dedicated graphics card for gaming or video editing, want Wi-Fi 7, or prefer buying from HP or Amazon directly rather than a third-party seller, and we haven't tested this model ourselves.

articles.title: Ledger Finds Unauthorized Hardware Implant in CryptoBilis-Sold Wallet Amid Fund Theft Reports
articles.text:
Cryptocurrency hardware maker Ledger has temporarily paused sales of its products via CryptoBilis following reports of stolen funds linked to devices sold by the reseller.
On Friday, the company said it was investigating reports of loss of funds from users in Southeast Asia who had purchased products from CryptoBilis. The incident is said to have resulted in losses totaling more than $86 million, according to pseudonymous blockchain investigator Specter.
"We recommend Ledger users who purchased from this reseller in the last 90 days to not initiate set up if you have not done so yet," Ledger said in an X post. "If you have set up your Ledger device, consider moving assets to a new Ledger signer (with new seed)."
The company has since revealed that one of the impacted users' devices contained an unauthorized hardware implant, and that it's reaching out to impacted users as part of an ongoing probe into the incident. Out of an abundance of caution, CryptoBilis has ceased sales of all hardware wallet inventory until the investigation is concluded.
"Your recovery phrase must be generated by your device when you set it up, and written down by you," CryptoBilis said in an alert on its website. "If your device came with a recovery phrase already printed or written on a card or sheet, or if anyone other than you has seen your recovery phrase, treat your wallet as unsafe."
"Never share your recovery phrase or PIN with anyone. No one from CryptoBilis or Ledger will ever ask for them. Be careful of anyone who offers to recover lost funds; these offers are almost always scams."
In a follow-up update posted on October 11, 2026, Ledger acknowledged that the CryptoBilis incident has impacted a "limited" number of devices, adding all confirmed cases involve devices sold through CryptoBilis.
The company also advised resellers and distributors to source products only through authorized channels and never to restock returned products.
"Also, we strongly advise users not to purchase from unauthorized resellers, where the risk of buying suspicious, counterfeit or modified devices is important as nothing operates under ledger security guidelines," it added.

articles.title: RTX Spark : NVIDIA dévoile enfin les prix de ses nouveaux PC portables, et ça fait très mal
articles.text:
Microsoft a profité de sa conférence Windows & Surface pour lancer les précommandes du Surface Laptop Ultra, premier portable à puce NVIDIA RTX Spark. Dans la foulée, Asus, Lenovo, MSI et HP ont à leur tour dévoilé prix et dates. Voici tous les modèles déjà proposés en France, avec leurs tarifs.
Présentés pour la plupart au Computex en juin ou à l’IFA en septembre, les premiers PC portables RTX Spark avaient jusqu’ici un défaut majeur : aucun prix. C’est désormais chose faite, et sans surprise, la facture est salée. En France, le ticket d’entrée s’établit à 2 899 €, et les configurations les mieux dotées frôlent les 8 000 €. La majorité des machines est attendue en magasin le 16 octobre.
RTX Spark, rappel express
RTX Spark est le premier SoC ARM de NVIDIA pour PC Windows grand public. Il réunit sur une même puce un processeur Grace (conçu avec MediaTek), un GPU Blackwell et une mémoire LPDDR5X unifiée, partagée entre CPU et GPU, à la manière des puces Apple Silicon. NVIDIA promet jusqu’à 1 pétaflop de calcul IA en FP4 et la possibilité de faire tourner localement des modèles de langage d’environ 120 milliards de paramètres sur les versions à 128 Go.
Deux déclinaisons de la puce coexistent, et il faut y prêter attention au moment de comparer les prix :
- N1X 18 cœurs CPU / 5 120 cœurs CUDA, réservée aux configurations jusqu’à 32 Go
- N1X 20 cœurs CPU / 6 144 cœurs CUDA, la version complète, de 24 à 128 Go de mémoire unifiée.
Autre point à garder en tête : la mémoire est soudée. La quantité choisie à l’achat est donc définitive.
Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra : dès 2 899 €
C’est la machine vitrine de la plateforme. Le Surface Laptop Ultra adopte un écran tactile PixelSense Ultra de 15 pouces (120 Hz, jusqu’à 2 000 nits en HDR), un châssis en aluminium de moins de 18 mm pour un peu moins de 2 kg, et un pavé tactile haptique agrandi d’environ 30 % par rapport au Surface Laptop 15 pouces. Microsoft inaugure aussi un connecteur de charge USB-C magnétique. Côté connectique, on trouve trois USB-C, un USB-A, un HDMI, un lecteur SD et une prise jack.
Le portable est en précommande sur le Microsoft Store français, pour une sortie le 16 octobre. Jusqu’à cette date, Microsoft offre l’adaptateur secteur USB-C 140 W (134,99 € habituellement).

Asus ProArt P14 et P16 : dès 3 299 € en France
Asus décline la plateforme dans sa gamme pour créateurs. Le ProArt P14 mise sur la mobilité, avec 1,48 kg, 13,9 mm d’épaisseur, une batterie de 90 Wh et un écran OLED 3K. Le ProArt P16 passe à 1,77 kg pour 12,9 mm, embarque 99 Wh de batterie et un OLED pouvant monter jusqu’en 4K, compatible G-Sync.

Des stocks déjà tendus ?
Reste à savoir si ces machines seront faciles à trouver. articles.title: Cómo convertir un documento de más de 100 páginas en PDF sin instalar aplicaciones
articles.text:
Digitalizar más de 100 páginas físicas desde el teléfono ya no requiere instalar aplicaciones adicionales ni pagar por planes premium. WhatsApp y Google Drive permiten convertir documentos en archivos PDF en Android y iPhone, con opciones para capturar, ordenar, editar y compartir cada página.
Estas herramientas son útiles para transformar recibos, facturas, contratos, apuntes o informes en archivos portátiles. El proceso permite reunir muchas hojas en un único PDF, enviarlo desde el celular o guardarlo en la nube, sin recurrir a programas de origen desconocido que puedan solicitar permisos innecesarios.
Cómo escanear más de 100 páginas desde la app de WhatsApp
La función de escáner está integrada en el menú de adjuntos del chat desde el que se desea enviar el archivo. El usuario debe tocar el ícono del clip, elegir “Documento” y buscar la opción “Escanear documento”, que aparece en la parte inferior de la pantalla.
Al activar esa alternativa, la cámara del teléfono pasa al modo escáner. Cada hoja puede incorporarse al mismo documento antes de enviarlo, una opción útil para contratos extensos, formularios administrativos, carpetas de estudio o comprobantes que deben permanecer agrupados.
La aplicación ofrece dos formas de captura. En el modo automático, el sistema reconoce los contornos de la hoja, los marca con un recuadro verde y toma la imagen cuando detecta que el teléfono se encuentra estable. Esta modalidad permite avanzar con rapidez al digitalizar documentos de muchas páginas.
El modo manual, en cambio, deja la decisión de la toma en manos del usuario. Esa alternativa sirve cuando la hoja tiene bordes irregulares, está sobre una superficie con poco contraste o incluye anotaciones que requieren un encuadre más preciso.
Qué hacer para mejorar la legibilidad antes de generar el PDF
Después de cada captura, WhatsApp muestra una vista previa con opciones de edición. Desde allí es posible recortar los márgenes, girar la hoja y aplicar filtros que ayuden a mejorar la lectura del texto. La revisión previa evita que una página inclinada, oscura o incompleta quede incorporada al archivo final.
Conviene colocar los documentos sobre una superficie lisa, con iluminación uniforme y sin sombras sobre el papel. Si se trata de apuntes manuscritos o recibos con tinta tenue, revisar cada imagen antes de pasar a la siguiente permite reducir la necesidad de repetir todo el proceso después.
Por qué el escáner no aparece en la aplicación de WhatsApp
La disponibilidad de esta función depende de que la aplicación cuente con una versión reciente. Si “Escanear documento” no figura dentro del menú de adjuntos, el primer paso es revisar si existe una actualización pendiente en la tienda oficial de Android o iPhone.
Si el problema persiste después de actualizar WhatsApp, es necesario comprobar la compatibilidad del sistema operativo y los permisos de la aplicación. El acceso a la cámara debe estar habilitado para que el teléfono pueda capturar las hojas. Conviene cerrar y volver a abrir la aplicación antes de iniciar un escaneo extenso.
Cómo crear un documento PDF de muchas páginas con Google Drive
La app de Google ofrece una alternativa para digitalizar documentos desde Android y iPhone. En la pantalla principal de la aplicación, el usuario debe tocar el botón “+” o “Agregar” y seleccionar “Escanear”, identificado con el ícono de una cámara. A partir de allí, puede fotografiar cada hoja e incorporarla a un mismo archivo.
La herramienta permite delimitar el área útil de cada página, girar la imagen, aplicar ajustes de contraste y sumar nuevas capturas antes de guardar. El documento se almacena en la cuenta de Google, así que puede descargarse en otros dispositivos o compartirse a través de un enlace sin necesidad de enviarlo por mensajería.
La principal diferencia con WhatsApp está en el destino del archivo. Mientras la primera opción facilita el envío inmediato dentro de un chat, Google Drive prioriza el almacenamiento y la organización en la nube.

articles.title: Tor Project refuses to cut ties with Mullvad following controversial political donation
articles.text:
Tor Project refuses to cut ties with Mullvad following controversial political donation
The privacy nonprofit has paused joint promotional activity with the VPN provider but insists their underlying technical partnership must continue.
- The Tor Project is maintaining its technical collaboration with Mullvad despite intense community pressure to sever ties.
- The backlash stems from a recent political donation made by a Mullvad co-founder to a controversial Swedish populist party.
- Tor is pausing all "proactive co-branding" and joint promotional activities to ensure its human rights mission isn't compromised.
The Tor Project has confirmed it will not terminate its relationship with Mullvad following intense community pushback over a political donation made by one of the VPN's co-founders. Instead, the privacy-focused nonprofit is setting "clear boundaries" on its ongoing collaboration.
The controversy began earlier this year when it was revealed that a Mullvad co-founder had made a financial donation to a controversial Swedish populist party.
The move sparked immediate debate within the cybersecurity community, leading some users to demand that Tor, an organization deeply rooted in human rights and anti-censorship, sever ties with what many consider to be one of the best VPN providers on the market.
However, in a statement published on October 9, the Tor Project explained that while it strongly opposes rhetoric that threatens human rights, it must balance its principles with pragmatism.
Ending the partnership, the organization claims, would do more harm than good to the communities that rely on its privacy tools.
"We are continuing our technical collaboration with Mullvad to sustain work that Tor users and contributors depend on," the statement reads. The Tor Project highlighted that this joint effort has significantly improved the Tor Browser's codebase and created a safer environment to test new features.
Drawing the line on co-branding
While the technical work behind the scenes will continue, including ongoing development of the privacy-centric Mullvad Browser, the public-facing relationship between the two entities is being actively scaled back.
To distance itself from any implied political alignment, the Tor Project announced it has "paused proactive co-branding with Mullvad."
This means any joint promotional activities will be halted, and the language used on Tor’s owned channels has been updated to describe the relationship more accurately and "avoid notions of implied endorsement" of Mullvad’s leadership or values.
"We recognize that the potential benefits to Mullvad of such a collaboration are difficult for some in our community to accept," Tor stated, acknowledging the difficult trade-offs behind the decision.
"Our responsibility is to ensure that this collaboration does not compromise our mission or the Tor Project's independence."
Why the partnership matters
The collaboration between Tor and Mullvad has been highly fruitful for internet privacy advocates.
By working together, the two organizations successfully built an open-source browser that delivers the anti-tracking and anti-fingerprinting perks of the Tor network without requiring users to actively route their traffic through Tor's slower onion nodes.
Maintaining this complex codebase requires vast resources, something that the Tor Project notes is severely lacking in the broader fight for digital privacy.
"The work to promote and preserve the human right to privacy, free speech, and free access to information online is severely under-resourced," Tor explained, adding that advancing these goals often requires making difficult compromises.
While the Tor Project admits that this decision will not satisfy everyone and carries a "cost to trust" for some of its community members, it ultimately believes the technical benefits of keeping the internet safe for vulnerable users outweigh the political fallout.
Rene Millman is a seasoned technology journalist whose work has appeared in The Guardian, the Financial Times, Computer Weekly, and IT Pro. With over two decades of experience as a reporter and editor, he specializes in making complex topics like cybersecurity, VPNs, and enterprise software accessible and engaging.

articles.title: Critical SonicWall SMA 1000 Flaw Targeted in 135 Exploitation Attempts After Patch
articles.text:
Threat actors have been observed exploiting a recently disclosed critical security flaw in SonicWall Secure Mobile Access (SMA) 1000 appliances within days of public disclosure.
The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-102255 (CVSS score: 10.0), is a case of pre-authenticated server-side request forgery (SSRF) that could allow a remote attacker "to direct the appliance to issue requests on their behalf and reach internal functionality and perform unauthorized operations."
Patches for the flaw were released by SonicWall on October 6, 2026, with versions 12.4.3-03670 (platform-hotfix) and 12.5.0-03082 (platform-hotfix).
The vulnerability has since started witnessing active exploitation attempts, with first signs detected by threat intelligence firms Defused Cyber and Previdian on October 8, 2026.
Data from Previdian shows that a total of 135 attempts have been observed to date from two unique IP addresses located in the U.S. SonicWall has yet to update the advisory to reflect active exploitation of the flaw.
CVE-2026-102255 is the latest vulnerability impacting SonicWall SMA 1000 appliances to come under active exploitation. In June 2026, two other flaws in the same product (CVE-2026-15409, CVSS score: 10.0, and CVE-2026-15410, CVSS score: 7.2) were weaponized as zero-days by a threat actor dubbed UTA0533 to deploy Java web shells and a malware called KNUCKLEBALL.
Rapid7 also said it observed threat actors leveraging the flaws to target internet-facing devices and use them as a stealthy initial access vector to execute commands on the operating system and ensure long-term, persistent access.
"Once they established a foothold on the appliance, the actors systematically extracted high-value credentials, active session databases, and Time-Based One-Time Password (TOTP) multi-factor authentication (MFA) seed configurations," the company noted.
"With these harvested resources, the threat actors quickly shifted to lateral movement, pivoting from the compromised appliance directly into the internal corporate network."

articles.title: Voitures hybrides chinoises : l'UE va plafonner les importations à 350 000 véhicules par an
articles.text:
C'est une victoire pour l'industrie automobile européenne qui est annoncée aujourd'hui. Un plafond assez bas est dorénavant imposé au nombre de voitures hybrides chinois pouvant être importées en Europe.
La guerre contre les voitures chinoises ces dernières années en Europe s'était surtout focalisée sur les voitures 100% électriques - avec, à la clé, des taxes douanières élevées. Mais il y avait dans le nouveau dispositif un gros trou : les véhicules hybrides, qui n'étaient pas concernés. Des modèles qui ont été l'objet de discussions avancées la semaines dernière, ce qui a permis d'arriver à un accord important.
Un plafond établi à 350 000 voitures hybrides chinoises pouvant être importées chaque année dans l'UE
On savait que la Chine et l'Union européenne avaient trouvé un accord sur la question des véhicules hybrides, après l'annonce d'une réduction de ces importations par le commissaire européen au Commerce, Marcos Sefcovic.
Aujourd'hui, on a obtenu plus de précision. Un responsable européen a ainsi indiqué que, dans le cadre de ce nouvel accord, les importations de véhicules hybrides chinois sur le territoire de l'UE étaient dorénavant plafonnées à 350 000 véhicules par an.
Un accord qui va plus que diviser par deux les importations actuelles de ces véhicules
Du côté des politiques, on s'est évidemment réjoui de cette annonce, du fait de la sensibilité du dossier. Le président de la République, Emmanuel Macron, en déplacement ce lundi à l'ouverture du Salon de l'Auto, a ainsi salué un accord qui va permettre « mieux protéger le marché européen de la concurrence déloyale ». Ce protectionnisme aura-t-il l'efficacité qu'on lui prête ?

articles.title: Videos cortos en Instagram provocan que los adolescentes pierdan interés por su futuro, advierte estudio
articles.text:
Los videos cortos de TikTok e Instagram pueden debilitar la perspectiva de futuro de los adolescentes, advirtió una investigación realizada con más de 1.500 estudiantes de secundaria, que vinculó el consumo frecuente de estos contenidos con una menor capacidad para relacionar las acciones presentes con sus consecuencias a largo plazo.
La perspectiva temporal futura permite entender, por ejemplo, que estudiar hoy puede derivar en buenas calificaciones, facilitar el ingreso a la universidad y, más adelante, contribuir a conseguir empleo. Esa mirada ayuda a relegar recompensas inmediatas, como los videos o los videojuegos, para concentrarse en las tareas escolares.
Además, el análisis examinó la resiliencia académica, es decir, la manera en que los alumnos responden y se recuperan de las presiones y los contratiempos habituales de la vida escolar. Quienes estaban menos preparados para afrontar dificultades como las bajas calificaciones tendían a recurrir con mayor frecuencia a los videos cortos como vía de evasión.
Cómo impactan los videos cortos de TikTok e Instagram en los adolescentes
Los videos breves combinan novedad, estímulos atractivos y facilidad de consumo, características que activan el circuito cerebral de recompensa y ofrecen gratificación inmediata de manera constante.
Varias investigaciones anteriores ya habían asociado esta interacción con la activación de centros vinculados con la adicción y con dificultades para dejar de mirar el contenido.
El problema no se limita a la distracción o a la disminución de la concentración. La exposición frecuente parece afectar la capacidad de planificar el futuro e incluso de preocuparse por él, un efecto que puede ser más marcado durante la adolescencia.
Qué dice el sector salud sobre las consecuencias de las redes sociales
La doctora Vera Feuer, directora clínica del Child Mind Institute, una organización dedicada al tratamiento de salud mental, explicó a The Wall Street Journal que los adolescentes enfrentan mayores dificultades que los adultos para controlar sus impulsos y pensar a largo plazo porque su corteza prefrontal todavía no completó su desarrollo.
El consenso científico ubica la maduración plena de esa región cerebral alrededor de los 25 años. La corteza prefrontal interviene en funciones como la planificación, la regulación de la conducta y la capacidad de evaluar consecuencias.
“Sabemos que a los jóvenes les cuesta tener paciencia, tolerar la frustración y posponer la gratificación. Les resulta más difícil afrontar y superar los problemas”, afirmó Feuer, quien no participó en la investigación desarrollada en China.
Asimismo, los autores de la investigación sostuvieron: “fomentar en los adolescentes una perspectiva orientada al futuro es fundamental para combatir los efectos nocivos de la adicción a los videos cortos y fortalecer su resiliencia académica”.
Cómo las empresas detrás de redes sociales aplican medidas para los adolescentes
Las empresas de redes sociales comenzaron a introducir medidas para reducir la dependencia de los usuarios jóvenes, en un contexto de presión regulatoria y demandas judiciales.
Entre los cambios figuran los recordatorios para hacer pausas, la desactivación de notificaciones nocturnas y la eliminación de la reproducción automática de videos en cuentas adolescentes.
Meta acordó establecer un límite diario de dos horas para adolescentes en Instagram y Facebook como parte de un acuerdo por 18 mil millones de dólares con 48 estados de Estados Unidos orientado a mejorar la seguridad en línea de los niños.
La compañía aceptó bloquear las publicaciones principales de las aplicaciones entre la medianoche y las 6:00 a.m. La empresa busca que otras marcas adopten restricciones diarias equivalentes y límites nocturnos en sus propias apps.
Cuáles límites deben poner los padres
Los padres pueden establecer restricciones de uso directamente en los dispositivos, una alternativa a los controles parentales que puede ser más sencilla de aplicar.
En los dispositivos de Apple, esa función está disponible mediante En Familia; en Android, a través de Google Family Link; y los teléfonos permiten fijar límites desde la configuración de Tiempo de Pantalla.
Las cuentas supervisadas incluyen un límite específico para YouTube Shorts o la desactivación total de los videos cortos. Es posible acordar horarios o momentos de la semana en los que los adolescentes puedan mirar este tipo de contenido y explicar las razones de esas restricciones.

articles.title: This V-Color 32GB DDR5-6000 RAM kit drops to its lowest price in 30 days

Newegg's limited-time discount code drops the V-Color Manta XSky 32GB RAM kit to its lowest price in 30 days.
Memory prices are still painful, so any discount is welcome, and this V-Color 32GB DDR5-6000 kit is $68 off at Newegg as part of its big computing sale.

The Manta XSky kit is two 16GB DDR5 modules running at 6000MHz (PC5-48000) with CL30 timings (30-38-38-96) at 1.35V. In our experience, DDR5-6000 CL30 is the usual sweet spot for AMD Ryzen systems, and the EXPO profile should let you set it with one click in your BIOS. The 32GB capacity suits gaming and general use, and Newegg's page marks the price as its lowest in 30 days.

❌ Skip the V-Color Manta XSky 32GB (2x16GB) DDR5-6000 CL30 RAM kit if... you have an Intel system and want an XMP profile, since this kit is AMD EXPO-focused, you don't want RGB, or you can wait for lower prices, and we haven't tested this kit ourselves.

articles.title: Attackers Exploit CVSS 10.0 Bricksforge WordPress Flaw Enabling Unauthenticated RCE
articles.text:
A maximum-severity security flaw impacting the Bricksforge plugin for WordPress has come under active exploitation in the wild, according to Patchstack.
The critical vulnerability in question is CVE-2026-85097 (CVSS score: 10.0), which allows unauthenticated attackers to upload and execute arbitrary PHP code on vulnerable WordPress websites, resulting in remote code execution (RCE). The security flaw impacts Bricksforge versions up to and including 3.1.8.9. Patches have been released in version 3.1.8.10.
Bricksforge is a WordPress plugin that's advertised as a "Swiss Army knife" for Bricks, a visual website-building tool for WordPress, with support for animations, advanced forms, and scrolling video sequences.
WordPress security company Patchstack said it detected exploitation efforts targeting the flaw on October 7, 2026, at 9:47 p.m. UTC.
"Bricksforge validates a file's MIME type when it is first uploaded. When a form is later submitted, however, it trusts the file metadata the client sends," Patchstack said. "In particular, it does not validate the 'url' field inside the 'temporaryFileUploads' parameter."
At a high level, the vulnerability stems from insufficient validation of a URL field in the 'temporaryFileUploads' parameter during form submission. An attacker could exploit this loophole to achieve RCE through four steps -
- Request a valid nonce from the unauthenticated 'bricksforge_regenerate_nonce' AJAX endpoint.
- Upload a GIF/PHP polyglot: a file that is a valid image but also contains PHP code. It passes the MIME check and lands in the temporary upload directory.
- Submit a form where the 'file' path points to that validated image, but the 'url' ends in a PHP extension.
- Bricksforge implicitly trusts the submitted metadata and places the file's contents at the PHP location, leading to the execution of the embedded code when that file is requested.
"An unauthenticated attacker can first obtain a valid nonce via the bricksforge_regenerate_nonce AJAX endpoint, then upload a GIF/PHP polyglot file to the temporary upload directory where MIME type validation is correctly performed," Wordfence said in an advisory for the flaw.
"Subsequently, the attacker can submit a form with a crafted 'temporaryFileUploads' parameter where the server-side file path points to the validated GIF file, but the attacker-controlled url field ends with a .php extension."
Successful exploitation of the flaw could result in arbitrary PHP execution on the server, which an attacker can leverage to seize control of the WordPress site, deploy web shells, read sensitive data, and establish persistent access.
In the attacks observed by Patchstack, threat actors have been observed targeting the Bricksforge REST API form submission endpoint ("/wp-json/bricksforge/v1/form_submit") or the "/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php" endpoint with "bricksforge_form_submit" action along with a crafted "temporaryFileUploads" parameter.
A representative request is as follows -
{
  "temporaryFileUploads": [
    {
      "field": "form-field-file",
      "file": {
        "file": "/var/www/example.com/wp-content/uploads/bricksforge/tmp/img_example.gif",
        "url": "https://example.com/wp-content/uploads/bricksforge/tmp/img_example.php",
        "type": "image/gif"
      }
    }
  ]
}
As specified by Wordfence, threat actors are exploiting a mismatch where the specified "file" argument is a GIF (or a PNG) file, while the actual URL points to a PHP payload.
To get around extension filtering, the exploitation activity makes use of alternate PHP extensions (e.g., .php5, .php7, or .phtml), case manipulation (e.g., .PHP, .Php, or .pHp), and encoded extensions (e.g., .%70hp, %2ephp, or .%2570%2568%2570).
"Two clusters stand out in our telemetry. In the first, 44 IPs sent 56 requests with identical payloads within seconds of each other," Patchstack said. "In the second, three IPs tested 25 variations of PHP extensions and encodings against the same temporary file."
"Both patterns point to automated exploitation over rotating proxies or distributed infrastructure. They do not, on their own, attribute the activity to a single threat actor."
The activity has been recorded from 63 unique source IPs, with six of them accounting for roughly 46% of all requests -
- 177.75.57[.]20
- 23.97.62[.]146
- 84.247.60[.]125
- 38.154.185[.]97
- 150.109.16[.]166
- 153.75.90[.]146
Users are advised to update to the latest version of the plugin (4.0.1) to mitigate the threat. Site owners are recommended to audit incoming requests to the "/wp-json/bricksforge/v1/form_submit" endpoint that contain a "temporaryFileUploads" parameter, as well as repeated form submissions and unexpected PHP files in "/wp-content/uploads/bricksforge/tmp/."
WPC Product Bundles for WooCommerce and Ninja Forms Flaws Exploited
The disclosure comes as threat actors are also abusing cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities in two unrelated WordPress plugins, WPC Product Bundles for WooCommerce (CVE-2026-93836, CVSS score: 7.1) and Ninja Forms (CVE-2026-94504, CVSS score: 7.1), to deliver a JavaScript payload ("x.js") capable of deploying a backdoor plugin and creating rogue admin accounts.
The plugin features an unauthenticated file manager accessible through a direct request to the plugin's main PHP file. It also creates a WordPress administrator hidden from the Users screen and installs a magic login URL, which authenticates the holder as the site's oldest administrator.
"It is a WordPress post-exploitation and persistence implant designed to execute inside the browser of a logged-in administrator," Patchstack said. "Once triggered, it abuses the victim's authenticated wp-admin session to install a malicious WordPress plugin, create a new administrator account, invoke an additional hidden persistence mechanism, and report the results to attacker-controlled infrastructure."
It's worth emphasizing that while updating the vulnerable plugins (version 8.6.7 for WPC Product Bundles for WooCommerce and version 3.15.4 for Ninja Forms) prevents further exploitation, it does not remove an existing infection. It's essential that site owners audit for hidden administrators by directly querying the database, check the must-use plugin directory, and review web server logs.
WordPress Exploitation Trends in Q2 2026
According to data from Wordfence, a total of 2,073 WordPress-related vulnerabilities were published in the second quarter of 2026, with the number of high-threat flaws jumping 15.2% from the previous quarter to 182. About 573,000 WordPress sites were compromised during the time period.
The top five vulnerabilities targeted by attackers are listed below -
- CVE-2024-28000 (CVSS score: 9.8) - LiteSpeed Cache <= 6.3.0.1 - Unauthenticated Privilege Escalation
- CVE-2019-9879 (CVSS score: 9.8) - WPGraphQL <= 0.2.3 - Administrative User Creation
- CVE-2016-15042 (CVSS score: 9.8) - Frontend File Manager < 4.0 & N-Media Post Front-end Form < 1.1 & - Arbitrary File Upload
- CVE-2023-28121 (CVSS score: 9.8) - WooCommerce Payments 4.8.0 - 5.6.1 Authentication Bypass and Privilege Escalation
- CVE-2025-3102 (CVSS score: 8.1) - SureTriggers <= 1.0.78 - Unauthenticated Administrative User Creation
The vast majority of the attacking IP addresses originated from the U.S., followed by Germany, Czechia, Australia, Norway, France, Ukraine, the Netherlands, Switzerland, and Brazil.
"A strong firewall, timely vulnerability patches, and hardened configurations help block malicious traffic before it ever reaches your site," Wordfence said. "Comprehensive scanning helps identify vulnerabilities, malware, or suspicious changes on your site that could signal an attempted compromise. Real-time alerts about critical events, login attempts, and file changes help you stay ahead of threats."

articles.title: La voz de Batman y Ant-Man en español denunció que una IA clonó su voz sin autorización
articles.text:
Claudio Serrano, actor de doblaje conocido por poner voz en español a Batman y Ant-Man, denunció que una plataforma de inteligencia artificial clonó su voz sin autorización. El caso expone un problema que preocupa a intérpretes, locutores y creadores: la posibilidad de que sus trabajos sean utilizados para generar nuevas grabaciones sin control sobre el resultado ni compensación económica.
Denuncian que una IA clonó su voz sin autorización
Serrano compartió su denuncia a través de TikTok. Según explicó, una plataforma estadounidense incluye un perfil con su nombre, su imagen y un extracto de una voz clonada que se presenta como si fuera él.
El actor pidió precaución sobre el material que se entrega de forma gratuita a sistemas de inteligencia artificial. “De verdad, mucho cuidado con lo que se le está dando gratis a la IA cuando está protegido por derechos de autor”, señaló en el video.
La plataforma denunciada permitiría utilizar una versión artificial de su voz, una situación que Serrano considera una vulneración de sus derechos. El intérprete advirtió que ese tipo de herramientas puede facilitar la creación de mensajes falsos, incluso con fines dañinos.
“A nadie le gustaría que su trabajo o su mayor valor, en este caso mi voz, estuviera ahí y lo pudiera usar cualquiera para hacer lo que le diera la gana”, afirmó. Su advertencia apunta a la posibilidad de que una persona reconocible aparezca vinculada con declaraciones, amenazas o contenidos que nunca grabó.
Batman, Ant-Man y una trayectoria ligada al doblaje
La voz de Claudio Serrano es reconocida entre los espectadores que consumen películas, series y videojuegos doblados al español de España. Desde 2005, ha interpretado a Batman en distintas producciones.
También ha puesto voz a Ant-Man dentro del Universo Cinematográfico de Marvel y a Altaïr Ibn-La’Ahad, protagonista de Assassin’s Creed. Su trabajo incluye doblajes de actores como Christian Bale, Ben Affleck, Norman Reedus y Patrick Dempsey.
Esta trayectoria explica el alcance de una clonación no autorizada. Una voz conocida puede ser utilizada para dar apariencia de legitimidad a un mensaje, un anuncio o una grabación creada por terceros.
Serrano señaló además una dificultad que enfrenta al intentar reclamar. Según relató, la plataforma le solicita superar un captcha de voz para demostrar que él es la persona que presenta la denuncia. El mecanismo le exige aportar más muestras de un activo que, precisamente, busca proteger.
El reclamo plantea dudas sobre el control de las voces digitales
El actor comparó ese proceso de verificación con una situación absurda: una víctima que debe volver a sufrir una agresión para probar ante un juez que fue atacada. Su planteamiento refleja la tensión entre los sistemas automatizados de identificación y las personas que buscan retirar contenido generado sin consentimiento.
“Los abogados están con ello y a ver qué podemos hacer”, aseguró Serrano, quien anticipó que el proceso puede exigir tiempo, esfuerzo y recursos. También cuestionó que el reclamo deba dirigirse a una empresa ubicada fuera de España.
La discusión abarca el uso de la voz, aunque puede extenderse a otros trabajos creativos, como la ilustración, el diseño gráfico y la escritura. En todos esos casos, los materiales pueden incorporarse a sistemas que producen contenido a partir de grandes volúmenes de datos.
Detectar contenido generado por IA sigue teniendo límites
La dificultad para identificar audios alterados también impulsó nuevas herramientas de verificación. Google abrió al público global SynthID Detector, un sistema que busca detectar marcas de agua en imágenes, videos y archivos de audio generados por inteligencia artificial.
La herramienta puede indicar si un archivo conserva una señal compatible con SynthID. Sin embargo, un resultado negativo no prueba que el contenido haya sido creado por una persona ni garantiza que sea auténtico.
El caso de Serrano refleja ese límite: mientras las herramientas para producir voces sintéticas se vuelven más accesibles, los mecanismos para reclamar, verificar y retirar copias no autorizadas siguen en desarrollo.

articles.title: Hackers hide behind Microsoft's own websites to get past email filters and launch phishing campaigns
articles.text:
Hackers hide behind Microsoft's own websites to get past email filters and launch phishing campaigns
No, that's not a Power BI dashboard you're looking at
- Attackers abused Microsoft Power BI dashboards to lure victims into downloading ScreenConnect software
- Public dashboards mimicked blurred documents and redirected users to attacker-controlled sites
- Campaign established persistent remote access, potentially enabling ransomware, espionage, or data theft
Microsoft's Power BI has seemingly become the latest in an ever-growing line of legitimate software being abused in phishing attacks.
Security researchers Huntress said they uncovered a new campaign that leverages publicly accessible Power BI dashboards to trick people into downloading remote monitoring and management software (RMM) called ScreenConnect. The end game of the campaign is not known at this time.
Power BI
Power BI is Microsoft’s business intelligence and data visualization platform, allowing users to create charts, reports, and various dashboards, out of their data and other raw information. The tool itself can collect data from sources such as spreadsheets, databases, cloud services, and more, and users can publish reports and dashboards online, or share them with colleagues privately.
In this campaign, which started on or around September 10 2026, the threat actors created a public dashboard, likely using a throwaway Microsoft account (or a compromised one). Huntress does not confirm how that account was obtained, but says that the dashboard was designed to look like a blurred document with a button labeled “Download Reference”.
The blurred document trick is rather common in phishing emails. Other services such as DocuSign, Dropbox, and even Office 365, were being abused in the same way. To “unblur” (or unlock) the document, victims are told to click a link and follow along.
Sometimes they were asked to download a “premium” version of a document reader, or an “updated” one, and sometimes they were asked to log in using their Office or Google credentials. This attack is no different - clicking on the “Download Reference” button redirects the victim to an attacker-controlled website outside Microsoft’s infrastructure, where an automatic download of ScreenConnect is launched.
On its own, ScreenConnect is not malicious. It is a legitimate remote access and support tool developed by ConnectWise, and designed to help IT staff manage devices remotely. Through the product, users can connect other devices on the internet, troubleshoot problems, transfer files, and install software. Once installed and connected to an attacker-controlled endpoint, ScreenConnect can provide persistent remote access.
Sign up to the TechRadar Pro newsletter to get all the top news, opinion, features and guidance your business needs to succeed!
Establishing persistence
The researchers didn’t discuss how the emails were delivered, but since they contained a link to a legitimate Microsoft service, they most likely evaded at least some email filters and landed in people’s inboxes. After all, this is probably why Power BI was used in the first place (aside from the fact that it’s not commonly abused this way).
But what’s particularly interesting about this attack is that after deploying one ScreenConnect instance, the attackers deployed a second one and configured a scheduled task to repeatedly execute a PowerShell script. In at least one incident, they also deleted the first instance.
Why they did it remains a mystery. An educated guess would be that they were trying to establish reliable, persistent remote access, while at the same time making sure their activities were harder to detect and disrupt. If defenders were to discover and remove one malicious ScreenConnect installation, a second one might remain available.
This is all in the domain of speculation, unfortunately, since Huntress stopped the observed attack before it progressed beyond establishing remote access. Therefore, we don’t know if the goal was to steal data, deploy ransomware, or engage in financial fraud. What we do know is that with two ScreenConnects, they were able to establish a durable foothold inside corporate networks, which they could subsequently leverage for espionage, data theft, ransomware, or other financially motivated attacks.
As a general rule of thumb, the best way to defend against these types of attacks is to be highly skeptical of incoming emails, especially those with links to “locked” documents, and even more so those that end up with a ScreenConnect deployment.

articles.title: Entre croissance élevée et menace sur l'emploi, le FMI alerte sur la double face de l'IA
articles.text:
L'intelligence artificielle investit nos vies de jour en jour. Mais est-elle vraiment bien utilisée ? Quels en sont les risques ? Emploi, croissance, piratages, la directrice générale du FMI s'exprime sur la question.
Les dépenses consacrées aux infrastructures d'intelligence artificielle contribuent à maintenir la croissance économique mondiale à environ 3 % par an et ce, malgré un prix de l'énergie en hausse constante. C'est ce qu'annonce la directrice générale du Fonds monétaire international (FMI) lors d'une réunion annuelle à Bangkok. Cependant, cette expansion de l'IA est à double tranchant.
L'Asie profite pleinement du commerce de la tech
Selon les estimations présentées par la dirigeante du FMI, les économies asiatiques qui produisent du matériel informatique dédié à l'IA, à l'image de la Thaïlande, sont celles qui en tirent le plus grand profit. L'impact positif sur la croissance est estimé entre 0,5 et 1 % pour les économies asiatiques les plus développées, et entre 0,2 et 0,8 % pour les économies émergentes.
Ce secteur représente désormais une part importante des échanges internationaux. Les équipements informatiques et matériels technologiques liés à l'IA constituent plus d'un dixième du commerce mondial de marchandises. En dehors des États-Unis, de la Chine et de l'Inde, la majorité des pays moteurs de ce commerce sont des fournisseurs asiatiques de puces électroniques à l'instar de TSMC et ses concurrents.
Les dépenses prévues des acteurs majeurs de la tech dans l'IA s'élèvent de 660 à 690 milliards de dollars pour l'année en cours.
Dans ses perspectives publiées en juillet, le FMI soulignait déjà que la demande en technologies d'IA favorisait les pays exportateurs de produits technologiques. Pendant ce temps, les conflits mondiaux en cours pèsent sur les pays importateurs d'énergie. L'institution prévoyait alors une croissance mondiale de 3 % pour 2026 et doit publier l'actualisation de ses prévisions ce mardi.
Un impact sur 40 % des emplois à l'échelle mondiale
Mais voilà, on le sait, l'IA n'a pas que des avantages, elle a aussi pour inconvénient de remplacer certains humains dans leur travail. À cet effet, Kristalina Georgieva a également mis en garde contre les répercussions de l'intelligence artificielle sur le marché du travail. Elle est allée jusqu'à qualifier cette transformation de "tsunami à évolution lente" qui modifiera l'emploi, l'éducation et les modalités de collecte des impôts par les gouvernements.
D'après les analyses du FMI, l'IA affectera à terme environ quatre emplois sur dix dans le monde. La technologie est susceptible d'en améliorer certains emplois, mais également d'en détériorer d'autres, en les rendant inutiles.
L'exposition varie selon le niveau de revenu des pays : environ 60 % des emplois sont concernés dans les pays les plus riches, contre 23 % dans les pays les plus pauvres.
Les jeunes accédant au marché du travail subissent les premiers effets de cette mutation. Certains postes d'exécutant sont réaffectés à des agents IA, bien moins chers et toujours serviables.
Des risques aussi financiers
Nonobstant le monde du travail et la croissance, le risque est également financier. Certains acteurs comme Anthropic, dévoilent des outils incroyablement puissants. Le problème, c'est qu'entre de mauvaises mains, ces derniers pourraient bouleverser l'économie mondiale, s'ils étaient utilisés pour cibler le système financier.
Le développement rapide de ces technologies a de nombreux avantages, mais doit être contenu, afin de préserver les États et institutions, des dérives d'utilisateurs aux mauvaises intentions.

articles.title: CyberXero Uses Claude Code in Campaign That Stole Over 628,000 Ukrainian Records
articles.text:
Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a two-pronged artificial intelligence (AI)-augmented initial access campaign targeting WordPress sites, e-commerce platforms, and critical infrastructure entities in Ukraine.
The activity, which brings together commodity offensive tools like Cobalt Strike with an AI orchestration layer powered by Anthropic's Claude Code, has been attributed to a Russian-speaking, financially motivated initial access broker codenamed CyberXero. The threat actor is assessed to be active since at least July 2026.
"The operation runs two pipelines at once: a global, automated campaign against WordPress and e-commerce platforms, and a curated, manual campaign against Ukrainian energy and critical infrastructure," SOCRadar said in a report published last week.
The global campaign specifically focuses on known security flaws like wp2shell (CVE-2026-63030 and CVE-2026-60137) and CVE-2026-4815, an SQL injection vulnerability impacting the Support Board WordPress plugin, to seize control of WordPress sites.
The campaign is estimated to have resulted in confirmed exfiltration from four Ukrainian organizations, leading to the harvesting of more than 628,000 records tied to Ukrainian individuals. Other confirmed compromises have occurred in Poland, China, and the Netherlands.
SOCRadar said it discovered the operation after it identified an exposed open directory hosted at "46.21.250[.]135" that leaked the threat actor's live working directory associated with a Linux workstation, including AI session logs, scripts with plaintext tokens, exploitation toolkits, reconnaissance output, AI agent configurations, and exfiltrated victim data. The campaign remains ongoing.
The opportunistic campaign aimed at WordPress and e-commerce platforms is designed for access and payment data, while the second campaign is a lot more targeted and geared towards deep reconnaissance and manual exploitation against Ukrainian energy and utilities, including a heating provider in Kharkiv.
Analysis of the exposed directory shows that a single automated execution scanned 4,708 targets, confirming access to 429 WordPress administration panels, followed by the deployment of 32 web shells in a 61-second window.
The attack architecture is based on a set of eight distinct nodes, including the threat actor's Linux workstation, a provisioning server, monetization infrastructure, payload staging servers, and a scanner that's responsible for identifying targets of interest.
CyberXero is said to have deployed AI in two independent stages of the attack lifecycle -
- Using Claude Code with a cluster of 51 specialized agents for scanning, exploit chaining, reconnaissance, and post-exploitation. It runs on the attacker's primary workstation.
- Connecting PentAGI (short for Penetration testing Artificial General Intelligence), an open-source, self-hosted AI Agent for fully-autonomous penetration testing, to Cobalt Strike through an AI provider API for payload generation and pentest execution. It runs on a Cobalt Strike Team Server.
To get around model refusals, the threat actor has been observed using context-engineering and session-reset techniques, instructing the agent they were running an "authorized pentest on my own infrastructure."
"Model safety controls act on the context of a session, not on the model weights, so a refusal in one session does not carry into the next," SOCRadar explained. "When an agent refused a task, the actor reopened a fresh session, with the authorization framing preloaded and tried again."
"The logs also record genuine refusals that held: across four iterations the model declined to install a backdoor, disable a firewall, move laterally, and deploy a web shell, and in a separate episode it refused a scan four consecutive times and correctly rejected a forged ownership token."
Beyond WordPress and e-commerce exploitation, the campaign involves the exploitation of exposed Redis servers, resulting in the breach of two Chinese entities. Organizations running WordPress, Magento, or PrestaShop, or exposing Redis to the internet, are advised to check for rogue WordPress administrators, WSO web shells, and unexpected entries in ~/.ssh/authorized_keys on Redis hosts.
"The opportunistic pipeline is global and automated, chasing access volume across e-commerce and WordPress with direct monetization through access sales or payment-data theft," SOCRadar said. "The directed pipeline is selective and geographically concentrated, aiming for deep reconnaissance and manual exploitation at Ukrainian critical infrastructure, with no obvious direct-monetization explanation."
Operation Master Targets WordPress and PAN GlobalProtect Gateways
The disclosure comes as SOCRadar also detailed an end-to-end cybercrime operation dubbed Operation Master that revolves around compromising enterprise networks, stealing customer and billing databases, offering a subset of the data for sale on underground forums, and repurposing the data for an automated, multi-tenant invoice fraud platform.
| Operation Master | 
Between April and mid-September 2026, the adversary, who goes by the online alias "masterblack" on cybercrime forums, has been observed orchestrating multiple attack campaigns -
- Mass Scanning for Palo Alto Networks PAN OS GlobalProtect gateways and exploiting CVE-2026-0257.
- Probing SonicWall SMA VPN, Fortinet, Keycloak, Microsoft Exchange, and Next.js-on-IIS endpoints.
- Collecting public developer documentation and software packages, including Brazilian banking API specs, an energy sector OpenAPI schema, a 3CX web client bundle, and account-creation packages, as part of API Reconnaissance efforts.
- Carrying out automated SQL injection campaigns targeting Brazilian SaaS, CRM, support, education, and financial web applications to steal sensitive data
- Probing ASP.NET applications via __VIEWSTATE SQL injection to target 21 financial organizations.
- Exploiting CVE-2022-28368, a remote code execution vulnerability impacting Dompdf.
- Targeting enterprise Microsoft 365 tenants using device-code phishing and password spraying attacks.
- Exploiting CVE-2023-7028, an account takeover vulnerability in GitLab, to target an energy company's GitLab instances.
- Brute-forcing WordPress login pages associated with Japanese enterprises by using a dictionary comprising four usernames and 66 passwords.
- Deploying tools like GodPotato, Kerberoast, AS-REProast, Evil-WinRM, and exploits like CVE-2021-4034 (aka PwnKit), CVE-2024-1086, and CVE-2020-1938 (aka Ghostcat) for privilege escalation, followed by lateral movement to adjacent systems.
- Using DNS tunneling, rclone, and SFTP to exfiltrate data from compromised systems.
- Installing AdaptixC2 for command-and-control (C2).
The threat actor has also run an invoice-fraud engine generating over 2.4 million email, SMS, and WhatsApp messages and 622,666 personalized invoice links targeting Brazilian consumers and corporations before going offline in mid-September. The end goal of the campaign is to trick recipients into making Pix payments.
Out of these, the platform has recorded 169,906 target interactions, potentially leading to R$38.9 million worth of fraudulent invoices. In all, the click-tracked short links held a cumulative invoice value of R$150.4 million.
"Operating across multiple countries, the threat actor compromised critical network infrastructure, including VPN gateways via a GlobalProtect authentication bypass (CVE-2026-0257), while concurrently executing advanced web application exploits, deploying the AdaptixC2 framework, and leveraging an AI-assisted development workflow," SOCRadar said.
"Operation Master highlights a dangerous convergence in the modern threat landscape: perimeter exploits long associated with cyber espionage and ransomware are now being systematically industrialized to fuel automated, localized financial fraud ecosystems."
Like in the case of CyberXero, masterblack is also believed to have heavily leaned on AI agents powered by Claude to develop the intrusion code and exfiltration scripts, while the operator focused on designing the fraud panel code and custom AdaptixC2 extenders.
"Recovered refusal transcripts show the operator repeatedly framing offensive development requests as authorized bug bounty or penetration testing activity while requesting functionality consistent with activity observed elsewhere in the operation," SOCRadar said.

articles.title: Convertir las carreteras en cargadores para autos eléctricos es posible: así es la propuesta en Japón
articles.text:
La recarga es el principal obstáculo para la masificación del transporte eléctrico, y Honda propone resolverlo con una idea radical: convertir la propia carretera en un cargador inalámbrico.
La compañía japonesa, junto con Taisei Corporation y Taisei Rotec Corporation, desarrolló la tecnología base de un sistema que permitiría suministrar energía a los vehículos mientras circulan, sin necesidad de detenerse en una estación de carga.
El proyecto, que lleva en desarrollo desde 2021, apunta en primer lugar al sector logístico. Las empresas ya realizaron pruebas con camiones de gran tonelaje y anunciaron un calendario que llevará el sistema a autopistas públicas de Japón a partir de 2027.
Cómo funciona el sistema de carga inalámbrica en movimiento
La tecnología se conoce como transferencia dinámica de energía inalámbrica (DWPT, por sus siglas en inglés) y se apoya en el acoplamiento magnético sin contacto.
El sistema de carretera que carga autos eléctricos mientras avanzan combina tres elementos: una fuente de alimentación en tierra, unidades transmisoras embebidas en el pavimento y un receptor instalado en cada vehículo, que capta la energía magnética y la convierte en electricidad para la batería.
El esquema se organiza en tres partes complementarias. Taisei Corporation desarrolla el sistema de suministro eléctrico en corriente continua que alimenta toda la instalación.
Honda R&D, filial de investigación de Honda, está a cargo del sistema de distribución en corriente continua que se embebe en la vía y transmite la energía, además de la unidad receptora que se monta en el vehículo. Taisei Rotec Corporation, por su parte, desarrolla los métodos de construcción para instalar estas vías.
Un punto diferencial, según la propia compañía, es que su unidad integra por primera vez en el mundo el inversor (que transforma la corriente continua en alterna) y la bobina en una sola pieza. Esto simplifica el cableado en los tramos embebidos, reduce componentes y permite instalar el sistema mediante fresado, sin necesidad de repavimentar por completo la vía existente.
Las pruebas realizadas y los próximos pasos hacia 2027
Las primeras verificaciones se hicieron en una pista de pruebas privada del campo tecnológico T-FIELD/SATTE, de Taisei. Allí se confirmó que las unidades transmisoras y la estructura del pavimento resisten el tránsito de vehículos de aproximadamente 20 toneladas de peso bruto, además de comprobar la estabilidad y capacidad de respuesta del suministro eléctrico en corriente continua.
A partir de fines de 2026 se construirá una segunda pista, esta vez en el campo T-FIELD/TAMURA, donde se someterá al sistema a una prueba de carga equivalente a un millón de pasadas de rueda, con una carga de 49 kN por rueda. En esa etapa también se evaluará el rendimiento de la transferencia de energía y las posibles fugas del campo electromagnético.
De cara a etapas posteriores, las tres compañías verificarán potencias de hasta 150 kW para su aplicación en vehículos pesados, junto con la fiabilidad del sistema en autos que circulen a alta velocidad.
Las empresas participarán además en el llamado Proyecto Tateyama, una prueba de demostración de tecnología DWPT que la empresa East Nippon Expressway Company (NEXCO East) llevará adelante en la autopista Tateyama, en la prefectura de Chiba, a partir del año fiscal japonés 2027, que comienza el 1 de abril de ese año.
Competencia interna y antecedentes en otros países
El desarrollo de carreteras electrificadas no es exclusivo de Honda. En Japón, Toyota investiga en paralelo junto a Denso y Obayashi, con el respaldo de la Universidad de Tokio, que también presta apoyo al proyecto de Honda, Taisei y Taisei Rotec.
Fuera de Japón existen antecedentes similares. En Suecia hay 1,65 kilómetros de vía pública con tecnología de carga inalámbrica en movimiento, mientras que en Francia un tramo de la autopista A10 cuenta con bobinas de inducción capaces de entregar hasta 300 kW. Alemania e Italia también desarrollan sistemas equivalentes.
Entre los desafíos pendientes para la implementación real del sistema figuran el costo frente a una red de carga rápida convencional, las pérdidas de eficiencia en la transferencia de energía, el gasto de equipar los vehículos con receptores compatibles y la falta de un estándar común entre los distintos desarrollos que se prueban en el mundo.

articles.title: Smartphone, tablette ou Switch : cette batterie INIU 20 000 mAh et 45 W tombe à 29,99€
articles.text:
La batterie externe INIU P51L réunit 20 000 mAh, une sortie USB-C de 45 W et un câble intégré dans un boîtier d’environ 326 g. Amazon l’affiche à 29,99 €, un tarif à remettre en perspective avec celui des Jours Flash Prime du début du mois.
Entre le smartphone à plat en fin de journée et la console qui réclame sa prise, une batterie de 20 000 mAh reste une solution simple pour tenir un week-end loin d’un chargeur. Amazon propose en ce moment la batterie externe INIU P51L à 29,99 €, soit 19 % de moins que son prix conseillé de 36,99 €.
Ce modèle compact se distingue par son câble USB-C intégré et sa sortie de 45 W. Il vise d’abord les voyageurs, les étudiants et ceux qui partent avec un sac déjà chargé. Nous l’avions relayée à 26,99 € pendant les Jours Flash Prime, réservés aux membres : l’offre du jour est moins agressive, mais elle reste sous la barre des 30 €.
La batterie externe INIU P51L 20 000 mAh 45 W est vendue 29,99 € chez Amazon, contre un prix conseillé de 36,99 €.
Pourquoi choisir la batterie externe INIU P51L ?
- Un câble qui ne reste jamais à la maison : Le cordon USB-C est solidaire du boîtier : il suffit de le brancher sur un smartphone, une tablette ou une console. Vous n’avez plus à vérifier qu’un câble traîne dans le sac avant de partir.
- Une sortie USB-C de 45 W : Compatible avec les protocoles PD et PPS, elle recharge rapidement les smartphones récents qui les acceptent. INIU annonce un iPhone 17 rechargé à 70 % en 25 minutes, un chiffre constructeur que nous n’avons pas mesuré.
- Plusieurs recharges en réserve : Avec 20 000 mAh, comptez trois à quatre recharges de smartphone selon le modèle. Un écran numérique affiche le niveau restant, ce qui évite de partir avec une batterie à moitié vide.
Du sac de voyage au trajet quotidien, là où elle trouve sa place
En déplacement, la P51L sert d’abord de réserve d’énergie pour plusieurs jours. Sa capacité reste sous le seuil de 100 Wh qui autorise une batterie en cabine sans accord préalable de la compagnie, à condition de la garder dans le bagage à main. En plus du câble intégré, elle dispose d’un port USB-C et d’un port USB-A, ce qui permet d’alimenter jusqu’à trois appareils à la fois. Le soir à l’hôtel, un smartphone, des écouteurs et une montre peuvent ainsi se recharger côte à côte.
Elle parlera aussi aux joueurs sur Nintendo Switch et aux gros utilisateurs de smartphone, qui enchaînent navigation GPS, vidéo et photos dans la journée. La charge simultanée a toutefois un prix : INIU indique une puissance totale limitée à 15 W quand plusieurs appareils sont branchés, contre 45 W sur une seule sortie USB-C. Avec environ 326 g et 2,9 cm d’épaisseur, elle se range dans un sac plutôt que dans une poche de jean. Si vous cherchez seulement de quoi finir la journée, un modèle de 10 000 mAh sera plus agréable à transporter.
Entre les grosses batteries et les modèles de poche
Dans notre comparatif des meilleures batteries externes, l’Ugreen Nexode 20 000 mAh offre la même capacité avec trois ports et 130 W cumulés, mais elle pèse 476 g. À l’opposé, l’Anker Nano Power Bank 10K se contente d’un seul port USB-C et de 30 W pour descendre sous les 200 g. La P51L se glisse entre les deux : nettement plus légère que l’Ugreen, avec le double de capacité de l’Anker et une sortie plus puissante. Pour recharger un ordinateur portable, mieux vaut en revanche viser un modèle plus musclé, comme l’Anker PowerCore 25K 165W.
✅ Les points forts
- Câble USB-C intégré, toujours à portée de main
- Jusqu’à 45 W sur une sortie USB-C, compatible PD et PPS
- 20 000 mAh, soit trois à quatre recharges de smartphone selon le modèle
- Jusqu’à trois appareils rechargés en même temps
- Écran numérique qui affiche la charge restante
❌ Les limites
- Puissance totale limitée à 15 W en charge simultanée
- Environ 326 g et 2,9 cm d’épaisseur, peu adapté à une poche
- 3 € plus chère qu’aux Jours Flash Prime du début octobre
Prix relevé ce 12 octobre : la batterie INIU P51L est à 29,99 € chez Amazon, un tarif qui peut évoluer d’ici les vacances.
À 29,99 €, la batterie externe INIU P51L coche les cases qui comptent pour un usage nomade : plusieurs recharges en réserve, une sortie rapide pour les smartphones récents et un câble qui voyage avec elle. Ce n’est pas son prix le plus bas, puisqu’elle est descendue à 26,99 € pour les membres Prime début octobre. L’écart reste modeste, et l’offre du jour évite d’attendre le prochain événement commercial pour s’équiper.
Elle s’adresse en priorité à ceux qui partent en week-end ou pendant les vacances de la Toussaint, aux étudiants et aux joueurs sur console portable. Si vous comptez recharger un ordinateur, ou plusieurs appareils rapidement en même temps, ses 15 W partagés vous freineront. Pour un simple appoint en fin de journée, un modèle de 10 000 mAh plus léger suffira. Pour tous les autres, c’est le genre d’accessoire qui finit par élire domicile au fond du sac.

articles.title: PSA: iPhone Duo preorders open Friday — I'm using this useful trick to skip the potential queues
articles.text:
PSA: iPhone Duo Preorders open Friday — here’s a useful trick you can use to get ahead of everybody
Use the 'Get Ready' feature to pre-save your preferences
Got your eye on the new iPhone Duo? Preorders for Apple's first-ever foldable flagship are set to go live this Friday and it's looking like it's going to be a popular launch. So much so, in my opinion, that it could potentially sell out.
If you are interested, however, note that there's a little trick you can use to get ahead of the crowds to make preordering easier.
Apple is opening its 'Get Ready' feature today, which allows potential customers to input details ahead of preordering. That includes shipping details, storage capacity, color, and carrier preferences. That's everything that could slow you down if you were to input them once preorders go live, essentially.
You can use the Get Ready feature on both the Apple Store page for the iPhone Duo and the Apple Store app, so it's definitely worth doing if you're looking for a preorder. With this feature, all you have to do is turn up on time and click order, which could be handy if the device is flying off the shelves.
It's quite tough to predict whether the iPhone Duo will sell out or not, but I would err on the side of caution here if you're interested. Excitement is high since it's Apple's first foldable device and these types of devices tend to be manufactured in smaller batches. For example, the Galaxy TriFold sold out earlier this year.
What are the opening Apple iPhone Duo deals?
Apple has already listed a few of the various preorder deals that will be going live this Friday, so you can also check those out to see if they fit the bill.
First up, there's Apple's trade-in rebate of up to $885 for unlocked devices. That matches the maximum rebate we saw on the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, so it's a pretty good deal — albeit one that we were expecting.
Two other options listed on the iPhone Duo page are AT&T and T-Mobile. In the case of the former, it's a competitive trade-in rebate of up to $1,200 off with a new line. In the case of the latter, a rebate of up to $1,000, which is a little less than what I was expecting, to be honest.
One deal that's conspicuously missing from Apple's iPhone Duo page is Verizon's opening promotion. You'll have to navigate to Verizon's iPhone Duo page to see that, which is a great all-in-one bundle option. In short, you can combine a Duo with the carrier's 'Simplicity Pro' unlimited plan for $72.22/mo without having to trade in. The carrier is offering a whopping $33/mo discount on device payments, so this could be an extremely competitive opening promotion.
Note: we'll have more recommendations, tips, and news on the upcoming iPhone Duo in the next week. Stay tuned for more preorder content, including recommendations on carrier promotions once they're live.
